_comment: Resume Roast outreach lane (2026-08-02). Job-seeker intent keywords for Bluesky discovery. Runtime overrides live in systemConfig.roastProspecting (merge: file defaults <- systemConfig). Lane ships DISABLED — enable via systemConfig, no deploy needed.
_killGateNote: 2026-08-07 CEO gate, mirrored in systemConfig.roastProspecting.killGate (runtime copy can be clobbered — this one is the durable record). Pre-committed test, measured at whichever comes FIRST: 30 further replies SENT past the baseline of 2, OR 2026-09-07. Then query productAnalyticsQuery?product=resumeroast&range=30d&metric=funnel. Fewer than 3 agent_run_started attributable to Bluesky => set enabled=false and move the capacity to camp-seo-search-intent. THE DATE IS LOAD-BEARING: measured send rate is ~0.4 replies/day (2 sent in the 5 days from 08-02), so the 30-reply threshold alone would not trigger until ~late October — a shelf, not a gate. If replies are still in single digits on 2026-09-07 that IS the answer: a channel that cannot deliver 30 touches in a month is not a channel. Do NOT measure across 2026-08-07 — resumeroast was split out of pixelagents that day, so earlier roast events are pooled with the 24-agent catalog and cannot answer this. Precedent: the AmbientScore cold-reply lane was disabled 2026-08-05 at 40 replies / 0 clicks; this gate exists so the roast lane gets a fair test decided in advance rather than an argument after the fact.
_selfExclusionNote: Added 2026-08-07. The lane matched our own Resume Roast promo post and queued a reply to ourselves — our marketing copy trips the resume-intent regex by design. The AS lane never had this bug because it requires a non-blocked site URL; the roast lane has no URL requirement, so it needs an explicit author/domain guard.
